description: Default error messages: the three low-level error signals (null-argument, argument, and out-of-range) produce their standard messages, with the parameter name appended and, for out-of-range, the actual value on a second line.

cases.expected_output:
outcome=threw
error=argument_null
param=arg1
message=Value cannot be null.

outcome=threw
error=argument
param=x
message=Value does not fall within the expected range.

outcome=threw
error=argument_out_of_range
param=idx
message=Specified argument was out of the range of valid values.
actual=-1

outcome=threw
error=argument_out_of_range
param=idx
message=Specified argument was out of the range of valid values.
actual=999
